question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, lt.term_start, lt.state, l.gender,
           CAST(SUBSTR(lt.term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as first_year
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
intervals AS (
    SELECT 0 as interval UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
retention_check AS (
    SELECT ft.id_bioguide, ft.state, ft.gender, ft.first_year, i.interval,
           MAX(CASE WHEN lt.term_start <= (ft.first_year + i.interval) || '-12-31' 
                    AND lt.term_end >= (ft.first_year + i.interval) || '-12-31' 
               THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as is_retained
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN intervals i
    LEFT JOIN legislators_terms lt ON lt.id_bioguide = ft.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY ft.id_bioguide, ft.state, ft.gender, ft.first_year, i.interval
),
retention_by_state_gender AS (
    SELECT state, gender, interval,
           1.0 * SUM(is_retained) / COUNT(*) as retention_rate
    FROM retention_check
    GROUP BY state, gender, interval
),
states_with_nonzero AS (
    SELECT state, gender
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
    WHERE retention_rate > 0
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT interval) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT s1.state
FROM states_with_nonzero s1
JOIN states_with_nonzero s2 ON s1.state = s2.state
WHERE s1.gender = 'M' AND s2.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY s1.state
